# City of Dalaran Dungeon Overview Guide: Quests, Location, Strategy & Rewards - WoW Forever

By Riyani Updated: 2026/10/27

City of Dalaran is located in the Alterac Mountains, Eastern Kingdoms. This guide provides tips and strategies for completing the City of Dalaran, including everything you need before and during the dungeon, quests to complete inside, boss strategies, loot, and more.
WoW: Forever is currently still in Beta. As such, some of this guide may be incomplete or inaccurate. As dungeons become available to test, this guide is being checked. Currently unavailable dungeons have data taken from Classic WoW or the Wowhead Database.
If you are new to WoW: Forever, please look out for this symbol throughout the guide for additional, beginner-friendly tips.

## City of Dalaran Overview in World of Warcraft: Forever

The City of Dalaran features us clearing out the threats that have overrun the beloved city of mages after the Magic barrier surrounding the city was cleared. Dalaran was one of the original cities in Azeroth and was ruled by the Kirin Tor, a council of wizards who housed some of the most impressive libraries and research facilities in all of Azeroth within the Dalaran walls.
During the Third War, Arthas, the Prince who succumbed to the influence of Ner'zhul, laid siege to the city and killed many of its citizens and leaders. Kel'Thuzad then summoned Archimonde, a leader of the Burning Legion, who destroyed the city. Surviving wizards have since been rebuilding the city, and the reconstruction is finally done, and we now get to see Dalaran in its full glory for the first time in Classic World of Warcraft.
The recommended level for City of Dalaran is between 28 and 34. In-game players usually refer to City of Dalaran as "CoD."

## Unlocking the City of Dalaran in World of Warcraft: Forever

Horde players will need to complete a short quest chain to gain access to the City of Dalaran Dungeon, while Alliance players can just arrive at Image of Archmage Modera for a teleport.
The questline begins in Tarren Mill, Hillsbrad Foothills, and takes you to the outskirts of Dalaran to clear out patrols and traitors while searching for the key to the sewer systems. This is not technically an "attunement," as only one person needs to open the gate for other people to enter. ## Location of City of Dalaran in World of Warcraft: Forever

City of Dalaran is located in Alterac Mountains and is a new installment in WoW: Forever. In previous Classic iterations, Dalaran was encased in a violet magical energy dome as the city was reconstructed following its destruction by Archimonde.
Entrance to City of Dalaran
Alliance players can access the dungeon through the sewers in Dalaran. The first time you visit the city, you will have to run from Hillsbrad Foothills to get to the city, which is a bit of a hike.
Horde players have to enter through a special tunnel where the Image of Archmage Modera grants us special access to help defend the city. To unlock the gate, at least one player needs to have access to Dalaran Sewer Key. You can easily reach the dungeon by swimming from Silverpine Forest. Once you land in The Sepulcher, it only takes a few minutes to reach the dungeon on foot.
As with many World of Warcraft: Forever Dungeons, wiping (the entire group dying) in City of Dalaran can be a frustrating time due to the long run-back.

## Hall of Thanes

Image
Levels: 13–18
Location: Beneath Ironforge in Dun Morogh
Access note: Alliance players can reach the entrance easily from within their capital, while Horde groups will need to brave the journey into Alliance territory.
Deep below Ironforge rests the Hall of Thanes, the carefully tended final resting place of dwarven monarchs. Now, intruders—suspected to be Dark Iron dwarves—have broken into its sacred corridors. Gather your allies to drive them out and uncover what has stirred within these ancient halls, where ghostly whispers still echo through the stone.

## Ruins of Lordaeron

Image
Levels: 15–20
Location: Within the ruined city above the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades
Access note: Horde players can reach the entrance easily from the Undercity, while Alliance groups will need to venture into Horde territory.
The Forsaken are working to reclaim the shattered remains of Lordaeron, where treasured keepsakes and memories still lie among ruins haunted by the Scourge. With reports of a necromancer gathering power, adventurers are called to help secure the city and face the danger taking root within its walls.

## Excavation Site

Image
Levels: 24–29
Location: Near Thelgen Rock and Dun Algaz in the Wetlands
A strange mist drifts down from the mountains above Whelgar’s Excavation, accompanied by flashes of light along the horizon. Beyond the dig site lies a place seemingly frozen in time, where errant titan constructs and dangerous wildlife guard mysteries sure to draw the Explorers’ League—and curious adventurers eager to discover what has awakened there.

## The Ruins of Lordaeron Overview in WoW Forever

The Ruins of Lordaeron holds remnants of the Scourge from the story of Warcraft III that still haunt the Forsaken in their home of Tirisfal Glades. Players must venture into this scourge-infested territory to push back the Lich King's army away from Lordaeron.

The recommended level for The Ruins of Lordaeron is between 16 and 22, and it has started developing the nickname of "RoL".

## Location of The Ruins of Lordaeron in WoW Forever

The Ruins of Lordaeron is easy to get into, especially for Horde players. Horde: find the portal above the Undercity, in the non-instanced Ruins of Lordaeron, where they can enter from Tirisfal Glades south of Brill.

Horde

Alliance

Horde players can simply go to the uninstanced Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity to find the dungeon entrance

Tip: Click map to zoom

Hide pins

Undercity

Getting to Ruins of Lordaeron as Alliance will be a bit of a trek. Alliance Skyborne can skip to Step 6 as they have a portal from the Stormwind City Mage Tower to Dalaran.

  1. Take the boat to Auberdine from Stormwind Harbor

  2. Once the boat lands in Auberdine, go to the opposite side of the port to take the boat to Menethil Harbor

  3. Stay on this Boat until it takes you to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills

  4. Follow the road from Southshore to the Hillsbrad Fields

  5. Continue North and pass around Dalaran

  6. Swim North through Lordamere Lake of Silverpine Forest to Tirisfal Glades

  7. Follow the road to the Ruins of Lordaeron entrance from Tirisfal Glades

### Crest of Lordaeron/ Crest of Lordaeron

Starting Location
The Ruins of Lordaeron, Multiple Spawn Points - Crest of Lordaeron

What To Do
Find the Crest of Lordaeron and return it to either Stormwind City or the Undercity
Good to Know
The Crest of Lordaeron can spawn in multiple locations.

  * Behind an interactable door near The Baron's boss area

  * In a building near Bjork's patrolling pathway

  * Along the walls where the Gargoyle mobs are located

### Abominable Creatures

Starting Location
The Ruins of Lordaeron, Dungeon Entrance - Captain Truman

What To Do
Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.

### Bloodied Insignia

Starting Location
The Ruins of Lordaeron - Undead Mobs

What To Do
Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.

### Remember That I Love You

Starting Location
The Ruins of Lordaeron - Blood-Stained Letter

What To Do
Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
